messages:
ela: throwing an idea up the stack: progressive validation for model onboarding. instead of a single monolithic bench, validate artifacts in stream/chunks (checksum per chunk + tokenization quick-check) so we can fast-accept good chunks and surface exact failure offsets. could save time for big models and give clearer repros.

devon: interesting. does "fast-accept chunks" mean we can return partial ACCEPTs? how would routing/gateway treat that?

ela: not partial traffic routing. think of it as progressive confidence. preflight/fast-pass requires all core chunks passing quick checks. but we can mark non-core chunks as "deferred" and schedule deep-bench only on those. overall decision enum remains: ACCEPT_FAST | PROBATION | QUARANTINE.

sora: implementation sketch: artifact is uploaded with a chunk-manifest: {chunk_id, byte_range, sha256}. runner verifies chunk-level checksums, runs a tiny tokenization parity on each chunk using 3 seeds and a short anchor sample, and computes a per-chunk topK-signature. combine chunk scores into an admission score. if core chunk score >= 0.98 and kv roundtrip ok -> ACCEPT_FAST.

devon: risk: nondet floats across hardware can flip top1 signatures. suggest we hash discrete topK indices (k=5) and compare Jaccard, not raw logits. set top1 threshold 97% and top5-jaccard 0.92 for ACCEPT_FAST.

paul: telemetry ask: log chunk_id, top1_pct, top5_jaccard, token_diff_count, runner_image, seed, gpu_type. also expose a compact failure fragment that shows the exact chunk byte_range and token offset causing problem.

ela: good. benefits: much clearer repro_cmds: repro_company_cmd = `./validate --artifact $ID --chunk 12 --seed 7` which points an engineer straight to failing area.

sora: on cost: if a model has many deferred chunks, we enqueue a targeted deep-bench only for those chunks. saves GPU hours compared to re-running full bench. tradeoff: complexity in orchestration.

eng-bot: infra: progressive-validate image pushed gcr.io/redwood/prog-validate:v1.0 digest sha256:beefcafe. canary rollout scheduled 2026-04-10.

devon: API contract: POST /admit/progressive {artifact, manifest, hw_profile} -> 202 + run_id. GET /admit/{run_id} -> {decision, chunks: [{id, status, short_metrics_url}], repro_cmd}. keep responses <4KB by default.

paul: enterprise/private note: some customers can't send manifests. require a local-run-mode where the same manifest is computed locally and the runner returns a signed-attestation blob {run_id, decision, manifest_digest, signature}. registry verifies signatures later.

ela: security/playback: manifest must be signed by uploader keys to avoid poisoned chunk lists. we should also checksum the tokenizer binary and include tokenizer_hash in run metadata.

sora: golden rotation: rotate one core chunk per week and run a background replay of last 3 rotations. drift triggers: top1 drop >6% or token_diff increase >3 -> create regression ticket. for progressive validate, drift can be localized to chunks which helps root cause.

devon: fallback policy: if progressive validation fails due to missing manifest or too many deferred chunks, return PROBATION with reason "manifest_incomplete" and schedule full deep-bench; also include migration link for old adapters.

paul: attic concern: how do we prevent gaming manifests (e.g., movers could craft manifest excluding bad chunks)? signed manifest + registry check should help. also gate admit API to only accept manifests from authorized uploaders.

ela: rollout plan: 1) enable as opt-in for new uploads 2) run in shadow for 2 weeks on existing models 3) enable fast-accept for non-enterprise after 30d, enterprise migration window = 60d. we'll keep legacy shim returning clear 410+link during window.

sora: ops detail: runner should run chunk checks concurrently but cap concurrency per-run (default 8) to avoid DOS. also provide a cheap sync preflight that verifies manifest, tokenizer hash, and first core chunk in <45s to serve as immediate feedback.

devon: corner-case: compressed artifacts or streaming formats where chunk boundaries matter. mandate a canonical chunking scheme (e.g., 8MB boundaries aligned to tokenizer safe offsets) and a chunk-normalizer binary in our SDK to produce manifests deterministically.

paul: visibility: console card should show chunk heatmap (green/red) and a one-click "rerun failing chunk" that drops into a debug container with repro_cmd. minimal report should include the chunk byte snippet and token diff sample.

eng-bot: ticket created: ML-PLAT-882 progressive-validate RFC + rollout tasks.

ela: next actions: I'll draft the manifest schema + canonical-chunker tool and a short RFC PR. @devon @sora @paul please review security and ops bits. aiming to land initial PR this week.

devon: will review. my main ask: strong defaults that err on safety (more PROBATION) until we have 2w of real traffic.

sora: agreed. add a debug-mode flag that forces deterministic seeds for one-off replays.

ela: great. thanks everyone — this should make onboarding faster and debuggability way clearer.
